E1S \u00b7 E1RAW.desc: E1: GP on log depth + depth threshold from the paid (depth, label) pairs; p = Φ((μ − u)/σ). Path: E1 straddle.

E1S \u00b7 E1CAL.desc: E1 passed through the honest out-of-fold small-sample probability map (same path as E1RAW).

ATSCF_MARGIN \u00b7 ATSCF.desc: Logistic classifier on honestly cross-fitted predicted (log depth, T0 temperature, spike log-ratio). Path: its own margin.

DEPTHCF_MARGIN \u00b7 DEPTHCF.desc: Logistic classifier on honestly cross-fitted predicted log depth only. Path: its own margin.

G3_MARGIN \u00b7 G3.desc: Week 18 direct GP classifier on the labels. Path: its own margin.

ATSAPPROX_MARGIN \u00b7 ATSAPPROX.desc: RC19 PHYSCF_ATS (closed-form leave-one-out with full-fit hyperparameters: an approximation). Path: its own margin.

SHQ \u00b7 STRADDLE.desc: Region: SHQ GP on the spike log-ratio (lengthscales shared by the 8 outputs + record quality); inside = mean ≥ log 2. Path: straddle.
